verdict.rationale: Shopify's docs say it offers officially supported libraries for the languages and frameworks developers already use, and that these libraries are versioned on a quarterly schedule. Hydrogen is also offered as a first-party framework for building headless storefronts. Missing for 10: a named list of SDK languages or packages with install and usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use Shopify's officially supported libraries to build fast, reliable apps with the programming languages and frameworks you already know.
Versioned APIs and libraries follow the quarterly release schedule described below.
